# Agentwright

> Agentwright is a starter kit for developers building SaaS products on Claude AI agents: Next.js + Postgres, streaming agent API, per-user cost metering, auth, billing webhooks, evals and an admin page. One-time purchase with lifetime updates.

## Product
- [Agentwright Starter](https://agentwright.app/): what is inside, pricing and how delivery works
- [FAQ](https://agentwright.app/faq/): price, refunds, license, stack, delivery

## Free tools
- [Claude API cost calculator](https://agentwright.app/tools/claude-api-cost-calculator/): estimate Claude API cost per request, per user and per month for every current model
- [Claude API pricing](https://agentwright.app/pricing/claude/): current price per million tokens for every Claude model, with caching, Batch API and worked examples (one page per model)
- [Claude model price comparisons](https://agentwright.app/pricing/claude/compare/opus-5-5-vs-sonnet-5-5/): side-by-side prices for every pair of Claude models (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) with the cost gap on real workloads
- [What a Claude app costs to run](https://agentwright.app/pricing/claude/cost/chatbot/): worked monthly cost of a chatbot, support bot, coding agent, RAG app, document summarization and classification on every Claude model
- [Claude Pricing MCP server](https://agentwright.app/tools/claude-pricing-mcp/): free remote MCP server (https://agentwright.app/mcp) with current Claude API prices and cost estimates for Claude, Cursor or any MCP client
- [Prompt caching savings calculator](https://agentwright.app/tools/prompt-caching-savings-calculator/): monthly cost with and without Claude prompt caching, savings and break-even calls per cache window
- [AI SaaS margin calculator](https://agentwright.app/tools/ai-saas-margin-calculator/): check plan prices against model costs to see gross margin per user

## Blog
- [Blog index](https://agentwright.app/blog/): practical guides on building and running Claude agent SaaS (cost metering, tool loops, MCP, evals, rate limits, billing)
